_comment: BIOMES BY ALTITUDE. The biome erosion is vanilla's peaks value (-0.9) above the snow line (terra_continental:alpine/above_snow > 0, blended over 20 blocks) and kept out of the peaks and slopes bands (>= -0.37) below it, so frozen/jagged/howling peaks cover only ground above the line and lower slopes get their ordinary biomes The giants' tops are above the line, so they get peak biomes too. Biome selection only; terrain reads terra_continental:noise/continent/erosion.
